sources.operator: Trung tâm Dự báo Khí tượng Thủy văn Quốc gia (NCHMF)
sources.attribution: Trung tâm Dự báo Khí tượng Thủy văn Quốc gia
sources.timeSemantics: Vietnam local time unless the bulletin/product explicitly states otherwise
sources.notes: Official Vietnamese operational reference. No explicit machine-ingestion, commercial-use or redistribution grant was documented during the 2026-09-17 review. Use citations/validation only until permission or machine-use terms are documented.

sources.name: NOAA CO-OPS harmonic constituents and datums
sources.operator: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS)
sources.timeSemantics: API exposes GMT/local phase metadata; adapters must preserve which phase field/convention was used
sources.notes: Treat as public-domain/open federal data unless a product-specific notice says otherwise; preserve NOAA attribution and product disclaimers.

sources.name: Vietnamese lunar calendar independently verified factual-date set
sources.attribution: Record source citations per fixture group
sources.notes: Fixtures store independently verified factual date mappings, not copied proprietary calendar tables or page text.

sources.name: Con Nước Việt synthetic mathematical fixtures
sources.notes: Use for exact mathematical unit/golden tests. Synthetic fixtures prove implementation properties but are not evidence of real-station accuracy.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Free Hosted API
sources.attribution: Open-Meteo and the underlying weather-data providers as required by source attribution terms
sources.datumStatus: not_applicable_for_weather; hydrology products require product-specific semantics
sources.timeSemantics: Adapters must store provider issue/run time and normalize valid times to UTC
sources.notes: Free hosted service is explicitly non-commercial and rate-limited. Do not route a commercial deployment to this source even though the returned weather data is described by Open-Meteo as CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Paid Hosted API
sources.attribution: Open-Meteo and the underlying weather-data providers as required by source attribution terms
sources.datumStatus: not_applicable_for_weather; hydrology products require product-specific semantics
sources.timeSemantics: Adapters must store provider issue/run time and normalize valid times to UTC
sources.notes: Paid customer API includes commercial-use rights for the hosted service. API keys remain deployment secrets and are never part of registry or public responses.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Self-Hosted
sources.attribution: Open-Meteo plus upstream model/data attribution required for the datasets actually enabled
sources.timeSemantics: Self-hosted adapters must preserve upstream model run/valid timestamps
sources.notes: Self-hosting removes hosted free-tier call restrictions, not upstream dataset obligations. Each enabled model/data source still requires source-level attribution and rights review.

sources.name: GEOGLOWS ECMWF Streamflow Service
sources.attribution: Contains information from the GEOGLOWS ECMWF Streamflow Service made available under CC BY 4.0
sources.datumStatus: discharge_not_stage; never infer gauge stage without local calibration
sources.timeSemantics: Forecast run and valid time must be stored separately; retrospective products are model simulations, not observations
sources.notes: GEOGLOWS data is CC BY 4.0 and permits commercial use with attribution. Treat discharge as modeled streamflow; converting to local water level requires validated gauge/datum/rating-curve or other calibrated model.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG precipitation
sources.attribution: NASA GPM / IMERG dataset producer and archive citation for the exact product/version used
sources.timeSemantics: Preserve product run (Early/Late/Final), product version, observation window and archive timestamp
sources.notes: GPM states its mission data are freely available and requests dataset citation. Commercial-use status remains UNKNOWN in this registry until a product-specific commercial-use review is recorded, avoiding an optimistic inference from public availability alone.

sources.name: NCHMF weather and hydrology operational feeds candidate
sources.operator: Trung tâm Dự báo Khí tượng Thủy văn Quốc gia (NCHMF)
sources.attribution: Trung tâm Dự báo Khí tượng Thủy văn Quốc gia
sources.timeSemantics: Preserve bulletin issue time, valid interval and Vietnam local-time semantics exactly as published
sources.notes: Metadata-only candidate until an authorized machine feed/partner API and its ingestion, retention, commercial-use and redistribution terms are documented. Do not implement unlicensed scraping as the production adapter.
